31700-G.s: The bill formally adopts the 2009 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (VAT compensation fund), setting expenditure and receipts at EUR 2,467,964 thousand and rounding out the amounts in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2009 or, if published later, the day after publication with retroactive effect.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (G) for the year 2009 belonging to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds (G) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

32123-G.s: The bill formally establishes the budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (VAT compensation fund) for 2010 at EUR 2,670,403 thousand in both expenditure and receipts, as required by Article 105 of the Constitution. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the act effective from 1 January 2010.
32123-G.j: The memorandum justifies the budget statement by reference to the constitutional requirement that the state budget be fixed by law, and describes the Belastingdienst's horizontal supervision and reduced number of traditional audits of municipalities and provinces.
q: Whereas, pursuant to Article 105 of the Constitution, the budget of expenditure and receipts of the State must be fixed by law
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat ingevolge artikel 105 van de Grondwet de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het Rijk bij de wet moet worden vastgesteld

32222-G.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BTW-compensatiefonds, the VAT compensation fund, in line with the autumn budget adjustment (Najaarsnota). It changes the expenditure and revenue figures in the schedule, with the amended amounts stated in thousands of euros and effect from 1 December 2009.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the 2009 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2009

32360-D.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget schedule of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (FES) through the first and second supplementary budgets and the closing budget, adjusting expenditure and receipt lines and recording the realised totals. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget schedule of the Fonds economische structuurversterking for the year 2009 is amended as shown in the schedule attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Fonds economische structuurversterking voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

32500-H.s: The bill formally establishes the legal basis for the BES-fonds and adopts its 2011 budget statement of 21,300 thousand euros, pending the Wet financiën BES. Article 1 lapses if the Derde Aanpassingswet enters into force first.
32500-H.j: The memorandum justifies the provision as a stopgap, placing the legal basis for the BES-fonds in law ahead of the pending Wet financiën BES, following Raad van State advice.
q: Because the Wet financiën BES is still under consideration in the Tweede Kamer, it was chosen to include article 1 so that, in anticipation of the adoption of the Wet financiën BES, the legal basis for the BES-fonds is established.

Ondat de Wet financiën BES nog ter behandeling in de Tweede Kamer voorligt is er voor gekozen het wetsartikel 1 op te nemen zodat vooruitlopend op de vaststelling van de Wet financiën BES, de wettelijke basis voor het BES-fonds wordt vastgelegd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised not to send the 2011 BES-Fonds budget bill to the Tweede Kamer until its concern was addressed: the bill anticipates a fund not yet legally established under the pending Derde Aanpassingswet, creating a lack of statutory basis and unclear accountability. The government's reply states that a provision (artikel 1) was added to provide the legal basis in the interim, to be removed once the amendment to the Wet financiën BES takes effect.
concerns: The budget bill lacks a statutory basis because the BES-Fonds is not yet established by law under Comptabiliteitswet 2001 art. 9, creating tension with arts. 1 and 12 of that Act.

32710-E.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the AOW savings fund (Spaarfonds AOW), originally set by the 2010 budget act and last amended in September 2010. It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the AOW savings fund for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Spaarfonds AOW voor het jaar 2010

33090-C.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of expenditures and receipts of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), fixing the commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants. It sets the amendment in thousands of euros and has effect from 1 December 2011, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditures and receipts of the provinciefonds for the year 2011
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2011

33240-F.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) by adopting the supplementary and closing budget figures, with amounts in thousands of euros. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2011
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2011

33280-B.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures by a total of minus 117,548 thousand euros and fixing commitment amounts for the general and integration/decentralisation grants. It also sets entry into force from 1 June 2012, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for 2012
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2012

33400-H.s: The bill formally fixes the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BES-fonds, the fund financing the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, at 32,093 thousand euros, with figures expressed in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force on 1 January 2013 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The budget statement of the BES-fonds for the year 2013 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the government's BES-fonds budget bill for 2013 to drop article 3, which would have deviated by budget law from the Wet financiën openbare lichamen BES by publishing the 2012 special grants overview in an annex, since budget laws should be limited to budget content and such deviations require an ordinary law. In its nader rapport the minister followed the advice, deleting article 3, the explanatory text and annex 3.2, and said the planned amendment of the underlying law is being considered.
concerns: The Afdeling held that the content of budget laws must remain limited to the budget of revenues and expenditures, so the deviation in article 3 does not belong in a budget law and should be regulated, if needed, by ordinary law.
The Afdeling noted that the overview covers 2012 while the budget bill concerns 2013, and that the May 2013 publication obligation remains, so the deviation was not timely or coherent.
The Afdeling advised publishing the 2012 special grants overview separately and giving priority to the announced amendment of the underlying law.

33429-(R1988).s: The bill amends the Military Criminal Justice Act, the Military Criminal Code and the Military Disciplinary Act to align them with recent changes to the Judiciary Organisation Act, the Judicial Officers Status Act and the Code of Criminal Procedure. It mainly relocates military criminal jurisdiction to the Arnhem court and modernises terminology, judicial appointment rules and mobile court provisions, with technical corrections throughout.
33429-(R1988).j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical alignment with the new Judiciary Organisation Act and related acts, and as modernising outdated references and terminology.
q: The present bill adapts the Military Criminal Justice Act, the Military Criminal Code and the Military Disciplinary Act to changed legislation.
Het onderhavige voorstel van rijkswet omvat de aanpassing van de Wet militaire strafrechtspraak, het Wetboek van Militair Strafrecht en de Wet militair tuchtrecht aan gewijzigde regelgeving.
d: appointment of military judicial members by royal decree
establishment of mobile courts in declared emergency areas by royal decree or military authority
special prison regime rules for military detainees, possibly departing from the Penitentiary Principles Act
execution of sentences in facilities abroad or other suitable places
II.J, II.K, II.Q, II.V, II.X, II.BB (arts. 10, 36b, 44a, 60a, 67a, 75a, 114 Wetboek van Militair Strafrecht)
various military criminal law rules to be set by general administrative order instead of royal decree or Crown
military commanders may issue penal orders abroad under rules set by general administrative order
guidelines for use of penal order powers set by the College of Procurators-General
royal decree determining that a threat of war exists
p: Military judicial members are appointed by royal decree on proposal of the ministers, with eligibility rules and a second reappointment possibility.

Mobile courts may be set up by royal decree or a designated military authority, and that authority may appoint judges, shifting appointment power from the judicial process to the executive and military.
Military prisoners may be subject to special regime rules that can depart from the Penitentiary Principles Act and detention may occur abroad or at other suitable places.

Military commanders may impose penal orders outside the Kingdom under executive rules, and a royal decree can establish a threat of war that triggers related provisions, with guidelines set by the College of Procurators-General.

33486-(R1994).s: The bill asks parliament to approve for the whole Kingdom of the Netherlands the 2011 treaty with Peru on transfer of sentenced persons. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts.
q: The treaty on the transfer of sentenced persons between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Peru, concluded in The Hague on 12 May 2011, is approved for the entire Kingdom.

Het op 12 mei 2011 te ’s-Gravenhage tot stand gekomen Verdrag inzake de overbrenging van gevonniste personen tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Peru ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk.

parties: Asks for explicit parliamentary debate and approval of treaties with direct-effect provisions rather than silent approval, and questions Peruvian judicial independence and detention conditions.

Especially for treaties with provisions binding on everyone under articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, these members believe the House should not approve them silently but should first hold a thorough debate.

Zeker als het verdragen zijn die een ieder verbindende bepalingen kennen in de zin van artikel 93 en 94 van de Grondwet, menen deze leden dat de Tweede Kamer deze verdragen niet stilzwijgend moet goedkeuren maar dat daar eerst een grondig debat over moet worden gevoerd.
Asks practical questions about the six-month remaining-sentence requirement, possible complications with onward extradition, and whether the semi-libertad scheme is adequately considered.
These members note that a sentenced person can only be transferred if the remaining sentence at the time of the request is at least six months.
Deze leden merken op dat een gevonniste persoon alleen kan worden overgebracht als het strafrestant ten tijde van het verzoek nog tenminste zes maanden bedraagt.

Questions whether Dutch enforcement may reduce Peruvian sentences to Dutch maxima and whether the transferred person's sentence can be adjusted to parole eligibility, touching on sentence-review discretion.
This means the Netherlands must enforce the sentence imposed in Peru and may only shorten it if the sentence imposed exceeds the Dutch statutory maximum for the offence.

Dit houdt in dat Nederland de in Peru opgelegde straf ten uitvoer moet leggen en deze slechts mag inkorten indien de opgelegde straf het strafmaximum welke in Nederland op het betreffende delict staat overschrijdt.

Criticises the rigid choice between semi-libertad and transfer, arguing cases should be assessed individually, and questions retroactive application to prisoners who could not have known the consequences.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the transfer treaty with Peru is approved but that the explanatory note must clarify whether prisoners on the Peruvian semi-libertad regime fall under the treaty. The government's reply explains that semi-libertad prisoners are excluded because that regime aims at resocialisation in Peru, and proposes to adapt the explanatory note accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory note on whether semi-libertad prisoners fall under the treaty was unclear and needed clarification, which the government accepted and will adapt.

33605-A.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Infrastructuurfonds) through a supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across infrastructure programmes. The explanatory memorandum states that only technical, accounting or audit-driven adjustments are included.
33605-A.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical implementation adjustments, accounting entries, and corrections arising from control findings, rather than any new or expanded powers.
q: This bill includes only technical implementation changes, accounting-related changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

33640-B.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), revising expenditure and revenue amounts and fixing the commitment amounts for the general grant and related grants for 2013. It takes effect on 1 June 2013 and applies retroactively if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the budget schedule attached to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

33750-XVII.s: The bill formally establishes the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) and adds that budget to the national budget under the Comptabiliteitswet 2001. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides entry into force on 1 January 2014, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation is added to the national budget referred to in article 1, first paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
De begroting van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking wordt aan de Rijksbegroting, bedoeld in artikel 1, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 toegevoegd.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the 2014 budget bill for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation but advises adding an explicit provision adding this budget to the Rijksbegroting under article 1(1)(j) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, since it is adopted separately for the first time. The Minister of Finance replied in a nader rapport that the existing submission would suffice but accepted the advice, adding the provision to the bill.
concerns: The bill should include an explicit provision that this budget is added to the Rijksbegroting, since it is adopted separately for the first time under the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

34200-I.s: This is a slotwet (closing budget adjustment law) that amends the 2014 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), adjusting expenditure and receipts by a small net amount in thousands of euros. It sets the budget change to take effect retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The difference from the original estimate is explained by lower pension premiums and a lower consumer price index.
Het verschil ten opzichte van de oorspronkelijke raming wordt verklaard door lagere pensioenpremies en een lagere consumentenprijsindex.

34200-XVIII.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2014 budget statements for the ministries of Housing and Central Government Affairs and for the executive agencies, adjusting appropriations and realised figures after the supplementary budgets. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: So it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have found good and resolved, as We hereby find good and resolve.
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze.

34210-H.s: The bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by increasing its expenditure and receipts by EUR 1.702 thousand, through a first supplementary budget. It takes effect from 1 June 2015, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the BES-fonds (H) for the year 2015;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), voor het jaar 2015;

34350-C.s: The bill amends the 2015 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants and adjusting expenditure and revenue lines. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the expenditure and revenue budget of the provinciefonds for the year 2015
Wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2015

34550-A.s: This bill sets the 2017 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructuurfonds, fixing expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2017. The explanatory memorandum excerpt covers budget mechanics for DBFM contracts, Kustwacht funding and project tables, with no substantive delegation of rule-making power.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2017 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34620-C.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), adjusting the commitment amounts for general grants and integration/decentralisation grants and the expenditure and revenue figures in the accompanying budget table. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the amended amounts take effect on 1 December 2016.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the provinciefonds for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the budget table belonging to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

34730-A.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force on 1 June 2017 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2017 (First supplementary budget)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2017 (Eerste suppletoire begroting)

35000-J.s: The bill establishes the 2019 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, setting expenditure and revenue figures by budget article in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2019 and is otherwise a purely budgetary act with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2019 attached to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

It sets the amounts in thousands of euros, makes the amendment effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, and applies it retroactively from 1 December 2019.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the municipal fund (B) for 2019 (second supplementary budget)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2019 (Tweede suppletoire begroting)

35450-A.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (first supplementary budget), changing commitments, expenditure and revenue across infrastructure items such as the main road network, railways and waterways. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 May 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2020

36250-B.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) for a second supplementary budget, changing the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and the integration and decentralisation grants. Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36350-A.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobiliteitsfonds, the transport infrastructure fund under the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, via a first supplementary budget. It reallocates commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, waterway and mega-project lines, with effect from 1 June 2023.
36350-A.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by additional funds from the coalition agreement and reprogramming of projects, without invoking new executive powers.
q: The adoption of the budget statements is done in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2022

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2022

36600-C.s: This bill fixes the 2025 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amounts for the general grant at €3,353,395,000 and for decentralisation grants at €198,943,000 under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and the entry into force date.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for grant year 2025 at €3,353,395,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2025 vastgesteld op € 3.353.395.000.

36800-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2026 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobiliteitsfonds, the mobility fund of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, in thousands of euros. It sets the commencement date of 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Mobility Fund belonging to this law, referred to in article 2 of the Mobility Fund Act, is hereby established for the year 2026.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Mobiliteitsfonds, voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Mobiliteitsfonds (A) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes not included in the text.
